verdict.rationale: Brex explicitly markets AI agents that follow up on out-of-compliance spend, fetch receipts, and offer policy help ('AI assistants do employees' expenses... fetching receipts, offering policy help' and 'review agent... follows up with anyone out of compliance'), plus an MCP server letting assistants query expenses/policy conversationally. However, there's no concrete evidence of the assistant proactively answering 'can I expense this?' before spend occurs or explaining specific decline reasons conversationally. Missing for 10: documented pre-spend conversational policy checks, explicit decline-explanation flows, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these AI behaviors in practice.
